description: Far from the slimes you're used to, this plushie looks more like a giant, slightly flattened droplet of light blue gelatin. An expression of perfect relaxation and a cute pair of blushing dots adorn its jiggly royal figure. It takes only a glance to hear the words, "I'm not a bad slime...!"

It is a surprisingly detailed plushie of a steel broadsword, the blue eye adorning the center of its crossguard staring ever on. A stiff blue tassel stems from the pommel like a prehensile tail with four-fingers, using them to grip onto an attached ancient scabbard. In all... the ultimate weapon for a pillow fight.

A big, body-sized pillow with a print of a golden-eyed, light blue-haired anime girl holding a small blue slime above her head, and on the back... Nevermind. Even with there being slime absolutely everywhere, there's nothing to hide the fact that neither sets of "tools" are "equipped".

A big, body-sized pillow with a print of a rather well-developed anime girl. She is blue-eyed and blonde-haired, wearing a foreign-styled yellow police uniform, complete with a pencil skirt and white thigh highs. On the back of the pillow, the same girl's eyes and uniform have both turned blood-red, her mouth open and her tongue out ready to receieve... something. ...Blood probably.

A big, body-sized pillow with a print of a... a janitor. He's an older gentleman, and judging by the questionable magazine in his hand, doesn't seem very reputable. ...Are you sure you even want to see what's on the back?

A profoundly large pillow with a print of a rather dashing queen, dressed in black, seated upon a jagged black throne with her legs crossed. She has a spiked reptilian tail, shell, and a pair of horns, yet on the back of the pillows she's-oHMIGOD

A big, body-sized pillow with a print of a grizzled, silver-haired mercenary dressed in a skin-tight sneaking suit. You can't help but feel that he doesn't look very solid. That is, until you it around and find a much younger, yet nuder, and undoubtedly far more 'solid' mercenary greeting you as he crawls out from the underside of a carboard box.
